# repository_ancestry_observation

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Records mechanically observed ancestry between repository commits so containment never requires human reconstruction.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ancestor_sha` | `string` | yes | Candidate ancestor commit. |
| `descendant_sha` | `string` | yes | Candidate descendant commit. |
| `relation` | `string` | yes | Observed ancestry relation. |
| `evidence_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of the mechanical ancestry evidence. |
